Description
Whether you are interested in investing in silver, engaging in silver collecting, or gaining a stunning piece of precious metal that has many functions, this 1 Kilo PAMP Suisse Lady Fortuna Silver Bar -Will not disappoint your expectations. The Pamp Suisse silver kilo bar is comprised of the Swiss minting corporation PAMP SA (Produits Artistiques Métaux Précieux). For more than 30 years, this renowned corporation has produced minted and cast products with simplistic elegance and expert craftsmanship – each item is the result of continued innovation and quality control that is exercised by every member of their workforce.
************Please note these bars do not have their original assay certificate, however they are tested for purity using our testing equipment.***********
************These bars are secondary market and may show slight signs of wear***********
The 1 Kilogram PAMP Suisse Lady Fortuna Silver Bars are widely recognized as one of the most appealing bullion options available on account of their heavy.999 fine silver content and beautiful sunken inscriptions .
This PAMP Suisse Lady Fortuna Silver Bars  main attribute is its appearance and high standards: it has unique markings and a mirror like finish that makes each bar eye-catching and highly recognizable.. PAMP kilo silver bar minted carries a higher premium than other bars of similar weight, but they are priced commensurate with their high quality.
Each 1 oz PAMP Suisse Lady Fortuna Silver Bar consists of one kilogram, or 32.15 troy ounces of .999 fine silver cast ingot, a hallmark that will not tarnish or corrode over time. The artistic cast pattern makes the Suisse 1 kilo fine silver.9999 unique from each other, adding to their collectible value.
Design of   1 Kilo
PAMP Suisse Lady Fortuna Silver Bar
The PAMP Suisse 1 Kilo Silver Bars feature the PAMP Suisse logo, weight, and fineness level on the obverse side. Each of the Suisse silver kilo bar comes with a unique 6-digit serial number inscribed on the front. The PAMP silver kilo bars are also stamped with the phrase “Essayeur Fonder” alongside a PAMP logo bounded by a rectangle. The stamp guarantees that the PAMP kilo silver bar used to mint is assayed and certified as authentic and of the best quality.
The 1 Kilo Silver Bar-
PAMP Suisse Lady Fortuna Silver Bar
features a highly glossed finish almost mirror like in quality.
